label: sparse: new token shortly after a v (original phase / <DEL>), low precision
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.03% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase (87% of mass) and at the <DEL> step (12%), essentially never in the copy phase, and never at t=0-1; peaks at t=3-5. Strongly enriched when v was input one or two steps earlier (prev2_tok=v 16x lift, prev_tok=v 13x), secondarily l or i, when the sequence starts with z (10x), and when the current token is a first occurrence (95% of mass), with current tokens 2, e, p, f most common. But none of these conditions is selective: v within the last two steps covers ~65% of activation mass at under 1% precision, and even stacked conjunctions (vv immediately before, z-first + recent v) stay at or below ~10% precision. Many sequences with v v x do not fire at all. Magnitude is weak (mean 0.13) and no tested variable clearly modulates it. Probably a hidden-state direction that no simple token predicate captures.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=z (+5.50), prev_tok=l (+4.37), prev_tok=v (+3.89), prev_tok=i (+3.72), prev2_tok=l (+3.53), orig2=v (+3.53). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.25), prev3_tok=z (-3.56), prev3_tok=- (-3.01), prev2_tok=z (-2.88).
